This is the story of the great war that Rikki tikki tavi fought all by himself. <break time="0.8s" /> He was a mongoose, a small animal that looked a little like a cat. <break time="0.8s" /> One summer, a big flood washed him out of the hole where he lived with his family. <break time="0.8s" /> He held on to a piece of floating grass until he lost his senses. <break time="0.8s" /> When he woke up, he was lying on a garden path in the hot sun. <break time="0.8s" /> A small boy named Teddy found him and said, Here is a dead mongoose, Let us have a funeral. <break time="0.8s" /> No, said his mother, let us take him in and dry him. <break time="0.8s" /> They wrapped him in warm cotton, and soon he opened his eyes and sneezed. <break time="0.8s" /> Every mongoose family has a motto, which is Run and find out. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki ran all around the table and jumped up onto Teddys shoulder. <break time="0.8s" /> Do not be afraid, Teddy, said his father, That is how he makes friends. <break time="0.8s" /> That night he slept on Teddys pillow, close to the boy.

이것은 이야기이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 큰 전쟁에 관한. <break time="0.8s" /> 리키티키타비가 혼자 힘으로 치른. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 몽구스였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 동물. <break time="0.8s" /> 조금 고양이처럼 생긴. <break time="0.8s" /> 어느 여름. <break time="0.8s" /> 큰 홍수가 그를 쓸어 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 굴 밖으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 가족과 함께 살던. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 꼭 붙잡았다 떠다니는 풀 한 줄기를. <break time="0.8s" /> 정신을 잃을 때까지. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 깨어났을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 누워 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 정원 길 위에. <break time="0.8s" /> 뜨거운 햇볕 아래. <break time="0.8s" /> 테디라는 어린 소년이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그를 발견하고 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 여기 죽은 몽구스가 있어. <break time="0.8s" /> 장례식을 치러 주자. <break time="0.8s" /> 아니야 엄마가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그를 안으로 데려가자 그리고 몸을 말려 주자. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 그를 감쌌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 따뜻한 솜으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 곧 그는 눈을 떴다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 재채기를 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 모든 몽구스 가족에게는 좌우명이 있다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 달려가서 알아봐라 이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 리키는 식탁 주위를 온통 뛰어다녔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 뛰어올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 테디의 어깨 위로. <break time="0.8s" /> 무서워하지 마, 테디. <break time="0.8s" /> 아빠가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 저게 바로. <break time="0.8s" /> 저 녀석이 친구를 사귀는 방법이란다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그날 밤. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 테디의 베개 위에서 잤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 소년 바로 곁에서.

The next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki went out. <break time="0.8s" /> To explore the big garden. <break time="0.8s" /> It was full of roses. <break time="0.8s" /> Orange trees, bamboo. <break time="0.8s" /> And tall thick grass. <break time="0.8s" /> There he found. <break time="0.8s" /> Darzee the tailorbird and his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> Who were sitting by their nest. <break time="0.8s" /> And crying. <break time="0.8s" /> One of our babies. <break time="0.8s" /> Fell out of the nest yesterday. <break time="0.8s" /> And Nag ate him. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Darzee. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> A big black cobra. <break time="0.8s" /> Rose slowly out of the grass. <break time="0.8s" /> It was Nag. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was five feet long. <break time="0.8s" /> From his head to his tail. <break time="0.8s" /> He spread his hood. <break time="0.8s" /> Which had a mark. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a pair of glasses on it. <break time="0.8s" /> Who is Nag, he said. <break time="0.8s" /> I am Nag. <break time="0.8s" /> Look, and be afraid. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki was afraid for a minute. <break time="0.8s" /> But he knew. <break time="0.8s" /> That fighting snakes was a mongooses job. <break time="0.8s" /> While Nag talked to him. <break time="0.8s" /> Nags wife Nagaina. <break time="0.8s" /> Crept up behind Rikki. <break time="0.8s" /> In the grass. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind you, Look behind you. <break time="0.8s" /> Sang Darzee. <break time="0.8s" /> And Rikki jumped high. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the air. <break time="0.8s" /> He came down. <break time="0.8s" /> On Nagainas back. <break time="0.8s" /> And bit her. <break time="0.8s" /> And both snakes slid away. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the grass.

The next morning, Rikki went out to explore the big garden. <break time="0.8s" /> It was full of roses, orange trees, bamboo, and tall thick grass. <break time="0.8s" /> There he found Darzee the tailorbird and his wife, who were sitting by their nest and crying. <break time="0.8s" /> One of our babies fell out of the nest yesterday, and Nag ate him, said Darzee. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then, a big black cobra rose slowly out of the grass. <break time="0.8s" /> It was Nag, who was five feet long from his head to his tail. <break time="0.8s" /> He spread his hood, which had a mark like a pair of glasses on it. <break time="0.8s" /> Who is Nag, he said, I am Nag, Look, and be afraid. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki was afraid for a minute, but he knew that fighting snakes was a mongooses job. <break time="0.8s" /> While Nag talked to him, Nags wife Nagaina crept up behind Rikki in the grass. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind you, Look behind you, sang Darzee, and Rikki jumped high into the air. <break time="0.8s" /> He came down on Nagainas back and bit her, and both snakes slid away into the grass.

다음 날 아침. <break time="0.8s" /> 리키는 밖으로 나갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 넓은 정원을 탐험하러. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳은 장미로 가득했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 오렌지 나무와 대나무. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 키 크고 빽빽한 풀로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳에서 그는 발견했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 재봉새 다지와 그의 아내를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 둥지 옆에 앉아 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 울고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리 아기 중 하나가. <break time="0.8s" /> 어제 둥지에서 떨어졌어. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 내그가 그 아기를 먹어 버렸어. <break time="0.8s" /> 다지가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 바로 그때. <break time="0.8s" /> 커다란 검은 코브라가. <break time="0.8s" /> 풀숲에서 천천히 몸을 일으켰다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 내그였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 길이가 5피트였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 머리부터 꼬리까지. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 후드를 펼쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 거기에는 무늬가 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 안경처럼 생긴. <break time="0.8s" /> 내그가 누구냐고, 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 바로 내그다. <break time="0.8s" /> 보아라, 그리고 두려워하라. <break time="0.8s" /> 리키는 잠깐 겁이 났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그는 알고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 뱀과 싸우는 것이 몽구스의 일이라는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 내그가 그에게 말을 거는 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 내그의 아내 내가이나가. <break time="0.8s" /> 리키 뒤로 살금살금 다가왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 풀숲에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 뒤에, 뒤를 봐. <break time="0.8s" /> 다지가 노래하듯 외쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 리키는 높이 뛰어올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 공중으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 내려앉았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가이나의 등 위로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그녀를 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 두 뱀은 미끄러지듯 사라졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 풀숲 속으로.

Soon Teddy came running. <break time="0.8s" /> Down the path. <break time="0.8s" /> To play with Rikki. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> A tiny brown snake named Karait. <break time="0.8s" /> Moved in the dust. <break time="0.8s" /> At Rikkis feet. <break time="0.8s" /> Karait was small. <break time="0.8s" /> But his bite was as dangerous. <break time="0.8s" /> As a cobras bite. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikkis eyes grew red. <break time="0.8s" /> And he danced up to Karait. <break time="0.8s" /> With careful steps. <break time="0.8s" /> Karait struck at him. <break time="0.8s" /> But Rikki jumped on his back. <break time="0.8s" /> And bit him near the head. <break time="0.8s" /> Teddys mother picked Rikki up. <break time="0.8s" /> And hugged him. <break time="0.8s" /> Because he had saved her son. <break time="0.8s" /> That night he met Chuchundra. <break time="0.8s" /> A sad little muskrat. <break time="0.8s" /> Who always crept along the walls. <break time="0.8s" /> Nag is everywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried Chuchundra. <break time="0.8s" /> Can you not hear him. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki listened. <break time="0.8s" /> And heard a tiny scratch. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a snakes skin moving on bricks. <break time="0.8s" /> He crept to the bathroom. <break time="0.8s" /> Where Nag and Nagaina were whispering. <break time="0.8s" /> Outside a small drain hole. <break time="0.8s" /> When there are no people in the house. <break time="0.8s" /> The garden will be ours again. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Nagaina. <break time="0.8s" /> Go in quietly. <break time="0.8s" /> And bite the big man first. <break time="0.8s" /> She whispered.

Soon Teddy came running down the path to play with Rikki. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then, a tiny brown snake named Karait moved in the dust at Rikkis feet. <break time="0.8s" /> Karait was small, but his bite was as dangerous as a cobras bite. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikkis eyes grew red, and he danced up to Karait with careful steps. <break time="0.8s" /> Karait struck at him, but Rikki jumped on his back and bit him near the head. <break time="0.8s" /> Teddys mother picked Rikki up and hugged him, because he had saved her son. <break time="0.8s" /> That night he met Chuchundra, a sad little muskrat who always crept along the walls. <break time="0.8s" /> Nag is everywhere, cried Chuchundra, Can you not hear him. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki listened and heard a tiny scratch, like a snakes skin moving on bricks. <break time="0.8s" /> He crept to the bathroom, where Nag and Nagaina were whispering outside a small drain hole. <break time="0.8s" /> When there are no people in the house, the garden will be ours again, said Nagaina. <break time="0.8s" /> Go in quietly, and bite the big man first, she whispered.

곧 테디가 달려왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 길을 따라. <break time="0.8s" /> 리키와 놀려고. <break time="0.8s" /> 바로 그때. <break time="0.8s" /> 카라이트라는 아주 작은 갈색 뱀이. <break time="0.8s" /> 흙먼지 속에서 꿈틀거렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 리키의 발치에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 카라이트는 작았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그의 독니는 그만큼 위험했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 코브라의 독니만큼. <break time="0.8s" /> 리키의 눈이 빨개졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 춤추듯 카라이트에게 다가갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 조심스러운 걸음으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 카라이트가 그를 공격했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 리키는 그의 등에 뛰어올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 머리 가까이를 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 테디의 엄마는 리키를 안아 올렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그를 꼭 껴안았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 아들을 구해 주었기 때문에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그날 밤 그는 추춘드라를 만났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 슬픈 작은 사향쥐였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 사향쥐는 늘 벽을 따라 살금살금 다녔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내그는 어디에나 있어. <break time="0.8s" /> 추춘드라가 울먹였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 소리가 안 들려. <break time="0.8s" /> 리키는 귀를 기울였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 아주 작은 긁는 소리를 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 뱀의 비늘이 벽돌 위를 스치는 것 같은. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 욕실로 살금살금 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳에서 내그와 내가이나가 속삭이고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 배수 구멍 밖에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 집에 사람이 아무도 없게 되면. <break time="0.8s" /> 정원은 다시 우리 것이 될 거예요. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가이나가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 조용히 들어가요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 큰 남자부터 먼저 물어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀가 속삭였다.
